newsitem.title: USA: News Corp in Primestar talks - source.
newsitem.headline: News Corp in Primestar talks - source.

text.p: News Corp Ltd is continuing discussions on merging its ASkyB satellite TV venture into Primestar, according to a source close to the talks.
"It's one of the discussions they're having," said the source. "The talks are continuing. In the next week to 10 days, it should be more settled."
Earlier, Variety reported one of the more prominent partners in Primestar, Time Warner Inc, was debating the structure of such a deal rather than rejecting it out of hand.
A venture with Primestar would replace the now-abandoned deal News Corp had reached several months ago with EchoStar Communications Corp DISH.O. Time Warner declined comment.
Primestar's partners include Tele-Communications Inc, U S West Communications Group, Cox Communications Inc, Comcast Corp, and Time Warner.

Tele-Communications President Leo Hindery has told Wall Street analysts and money managers in recent days about his optimism for a deal and predicted it could be announced this week, unnamed sources told Variety.
A TCI spokeswoman confirmed talks at the highest levels of the companies were "ongoing," but she declined to comment further, Variety said.
